name: cors
description: Enable Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) on your API.

fields.name: origins
fields.label: Allowed Origins (comma separated)
fields.description: List of allowed domains for the Access-Control-Allow-Origin header.

fields.name: headers
fields.label: Allowed Headers (comma separated)
fields.description: List of allowed HTTP request headers.

fields.name: credentials
fields.label: Allow Credentials
fields.description: Flag to determine whether the Access-Control-Allow-Credentials header should be sent as true.

fields.name: max_age
fields.label: Max Age (seconds)
fields.description: Indicates how long the results of a preflight request can be cached.
